displayProperties.description:
A fragment of Eramis's armor. A reflection of what could have been.

Perhaps a place can be found for it at the campsite.

"…no home would be complete without…"

"…reforms cells endlessly in the comfort of your own home…"
"…rich shag carpeting…"
"…keys that open endless doors between realms of madness and order…"

You do not think it would be wise to read any further.

(This item can be safely discarded.)

"…complimentary continental breakfast…"
"…transmutes flesh into a fine mist…"
"…cruise in elegance and style…"
"…unbound by the limits of linear time…"
"…largest wooden rollercoaster in the Andromeda Galaxy…" 

On second thought, you feel as though you don't need a vacation that badly.

(This item can be safely discarded.)

displayProperties.description:
• Equip a Festival Masquerader's Mask to earn Candy by completing activities and defeating combatants throughout the system.

• Candy can be used to purchase Eerie Weapon Engrams, as well as focus Exotic Archetype armor.

• Complete Haunted Altars of Sorrow and Red Rum(ble) to earn Eerie Weapon Engrams, which contain Event weapons and Holofoil weapons.

• Complete daily and weekly challenges and activities, located in the Event Home, to earn an Event Rank and unlock Event rewards!

• Use the Haunted Mask in the Event Home to earn new Festival masks and purchase upgrades by using Candy.

displayProperties.description:
Deposit Dark Matter Ingots at the Totality Division War Chest to earn Reputation with this Syndicate. Reputation unlocks access to many rewards:

• The Totality gear shop, where you can directly purchase Modified B-7 Pistol and Praxic Blade modifiers for Credits. You also receive additional gear when you increase your reputation rank.

• Renegade Abilities can be unlocked and purchased from Armorer Aghol.

• Weekly shipments, which can be increased in size based on your current Reputation.
displayProperties.name: TOTALITY REPUTATION INFO

displayProperties.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• Dark Matter Ingots can be deposited at the Totality Division War Chest in exchange for Reputation and gear, including a chance for Modified B-7 Pistol. 

• The Imperium Pod Renegade Ability can be upgraded up to Level 4.

• Small Weekly Shipments can be earned by completing Totality Division Priority Contracts.
displayProperties.name: Rank 1

displayProperties.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• You can access the Totality gear shop and purchase Modified B-7 Pistol and Crystal Strength I for Credits.

• The Totality Division shares their access codes, allowing access to some locked areas in the Lawless Frontier.
displayProperties.name: Rank 2

displayProperties.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• The Imperium Behemoth Renegade Ability can be purchased and upgraded through Level 4 for Credits.

• Large Weekly Shipments can be earned.

• Higher quality Totality Division Contracts can appear.
displayProperties.name: Rank 3

displayProperties.description:
Grants the following benefits:

• All gear shops in the Tharsis Bazaar offer 1 additional discounted purchase per day.

• The Totality gear shop also offers 2 discounted purchases of Modified B-7 Pistol
 per day.

• Crystal Strength II can be purchased in the Totality Division gear shop.

• Totality Division Renegade Abilities can be upgraded to level 6.
displayProperties.name: Rank 4

displayProperties.description:

• The Totality gear shop offers 3 discounted purchases of the Modified B-7 Pistol per day.

• Massive Weekly Shipments can be earned.

• Totality Division Renegade Abilities can be fully upgraded.

displayProperties.description:
A master of Void Light, the Voidwalker empowers their own health and ability regeneration, while dealing massive damage to groups of targets.

This build is focused on defeating targets to gain health and ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Voidwalker

displayProperties.description:
A master of conflagration, the Dawnblade uses Solar Light to soar through the skies, spreading flames across the battlefield. They focus on igniting their targets, leaving only ashes in their wake.

This build is focused on setting fire to targets until they explode.
displayProperties.name: Dawnblade

displayProperties.description:
The embodiment of the tempest itself, the Stormcaller uses Arc Light to cast lightning down upon their targets. They amplify their own damage while smiting targets with powerful bursts of energy.

This build is focused on amplifying Arc weapon damage and ability regeneration.
displayProperties.name: Stormcaller

displayProperties.description:
A master of melee attacks, the Striker embodies the power of lightning itself. They use incredible speed to get up close and personal with targets, before delivering devastating strikes.

This build is focused on closing distance with targets and delivering high-impact damage.
displayProperties.name: Striker

displayProperties.description:
A master of fire, the Sunbreaker uses Solar Light to spread incinerating flames across the battlefield. They use grenades and throwing hammers to create Sunspots, which empower their allies and melt their targets.

This build is focused on using Sunspots to heal yourself and damage your targets.
displayProperties.name: Sunbreaker

displayProperties.description:
A bastion of defense, the Sentinel uses their Void Light to create protective barriers. They are unmovable bulwarks, conjuring overshields to protect against even the strongest of attacks.

This build is focused on using defensive abilities to shield yourself and your allies.
displayProperties.name: Sentinel

displayProperties.description:
A master of weaponry, the Gunslinger uses their arsenal of Solar-infused guns, blades, and explosives to deal devastating damage to their targets.

This build is focused on abilities that cause explosive chain reactions.
displayProperties.name: Gunslinger

displayProperties.description:
A master of acrobatics, the Arcstrider uses agility to strike in quick succession, disorienting targets and landing devastating melee attacks.

This build is focused on weaving abilities together in powerful combinations.
displayProperties.name: Arcstrider

displayProperties.description:
A master of stealth, the Nightstalker uses Void Light to conceal themselves and ambush their targets. Their mastery of traps and snares allows them to control the battlefield from the shadows.

This build is focused on using invisibility to ambush targets.
displayProperties.name: Nightstalker

displayProperties.description: Quick successive attacks with Arc Staff increase its damage output and duration.
displayProperties.name: Synapse Junctions

displayProperties.description: Arcbolt Grenades have increased chaining capabilities and jolt targets hit. Damaging combatants with jolt or applying jolt to targets grants additional Arcbolt Grenade energy.

displayProperties.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Dodging temporarily increases this benefit, reloads your equipped weapon from reserves, grants improved movement speed, and increases your class ability stat.

displayProperties.description: Provides radar while you're aiming. Enhances your radar resolution while crouched. Visually marks targets. Deals more damage to low-health marked targets. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
displayProperties.name: Upgraded Sensor Pack

displayProperties.description: Precision final blows reduce the cooldown of your Super. Modifies Golden Gun to fire a single, high-damage shot. Targets defeated by that shot give you Super energy and explode.
displayProperties.name: Hawkeye Hack

displayProperties.description: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability temporarily increases weapon damage of the same type. Defeating that marked target with damage that matches the element creates an elemental pickup.
displayProperties.name: Relentless Tracker

displayProperties.description: Improves sprint, slide, and airborne effectiveness while a Hand Cannon is equipped. For a short time after being drawn, Hand Cannons ready faster, are more accurate, and each hit against a combatant increases Hand Cannon damage.
displayProperties.name: Illegally Modded Holster

displayProperties.description: Provides ability energy for each target tethered by Deadfall anchors. Moebius Quiver has an additional shot.
displayProperties.name: Uncanny Arrows

displayProperties.description: Increases sprint speed and slide distance, and improves High Jump, Strafe Jump, and Triple Jump. Take less damage from targets when airborne.
displayProperties.name: Hydraulic Boosters

displayProperties.description: Melee hits grant Armor Charge, and you take less melee damage while you have Armor Charge. Taking melee damage causes you to emit a burst of damaging Arc energy that Jolts targets, consuming your Armor Charge and dealing more damage based on the number of stacks consumed.
displayProperties.name: Fury Conductors

displayProperties.description:
Defeating targets with Void damage has a chance to grant an escalating bonus to damage with Void weapons. Defeating targets with Void melee grants Super energy.

While Sentinel Shield is active, defeating targets with melee attacks recharges Shield Throw, which extends your Super on hitting a target.
displayProperties.name: Horns of Doom

displayProperties.description: When you're surrounded, gain increased melee and Super damage, as well as improved weapon handling and reload speed.
displayProperties.name: Biotic Enhancements

displayProperties.description: Generates an additional Orb of Power from Supers. Generating a Barricade, or dealing sustained damage or defeating targets from behind one creates a healing pulse. Healing your allies grants Barricade energy.
displayProperties.name: Survival Well

displayProperties.description: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Auto Rifle or Machine Gun's magazine from reserves. Final blows with Auto Rifles or Machine Guns boost their stability, ammo generation, and damage. Provides a moderate benefit to their airborne effectiveness.
displayProperties.name: Auto-Loading Link

displayProperties.description: Solar final blows while standing in a Sunspot create a Sunspot. Greatly improves recharge rate of your melee and grenade while your Solar Super is charged. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
displayProperties.name: Sunfire Furnace

displayProperties.description: Final blows with Arc melees trigger health regeneration and fully restore a melee charge. Melee hits grant Arc melee energy.
displayProperties.name: Transfusion Matrix

displayProperties.description: Grants ability energy when you are damaged. While you have a Void super equipped, rapid final blows and final blows while critically wounded grant Devour.
displayProperties.name: Dreaded Visage

displayProperties.description: Increases hip-fire range and accuracy for Primary ammo weapons. Grants additional aerial maneuverability and enables airborne firing during Lift. Increases the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.
displayProperties.name: Jump Jets

displayProperties.description: While wielding a Submachine Gun, handling, airborne effectiveness, and movement are all improved, and damage against combatants will increase the longer you remain on target. Submachine Guns are reloaded when stowed.
displayProperties.name: Mecha Holster

displayProperties.description: Increases sprint speed. Sprinting builds up a static charge. After melee-attacking a combatant, that charge will chain damage to nearby foes. Gain Bolt Charge per target hit by the chain.
displayProperties.name: Linear Actuators

displayProperties.description: Increases the duration of Solar Grenades. Solar melee kills grant unlimited Solar Grenade energy for a brief time.
displayProperties.name: Helium Spirals

displayProperties.description: Melee and finisher final blows instantly grant cure and provide restoration for a short duration.
displayProperties.name: Vampire's Caress

displayProperties.description: Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage. With maximum stacks, you gain vastly increased melee regeneration speed for a short time.
displayProperties.name: Warlord's Sigil

displayProperties.description: Fusion Grenades have an additional charge and recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy. Defeating targets with Fusion Grenades grant Rift energy.

displayProperties.description: While you have a [Solar]Solar Super equipped, aiming weapons while you're midair suspends you there for a short time. While this effect is active, you are more resistant to incoming damage and combatants are less accurate. Weapon hits extend this effect's duration, and [Solar]Solar weapon final blows provide Restoration and reload your other weapons from reserves. Provides a large benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

displayProperties.description: Provides additional damage resistance during Nova Bomb. Nova Bomb final blows and weapon final blows while you have Devour grant Super energy.

displayProperties.description: While you have an Arc ability equipped, Arc ability or Jolt final blows increase the recharge rate of your abilities and extend the duration of Stormtrance.

displayProperties.description:
Dodging leaves behind an explosive that detonates after a short delay, damaging targets around it and creating a secondary effect based on your Super's element:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Suppresses targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
displayProperties.name: Parting Gift

displayProperties.description: While a Solar Super is equipped, weapon final blows grant class ability energy. Defeating targets with your weapon while standing in a healing rift creates a pulse that grants Radiant to you and nearby allies; an empowering rift instead grants Cure to you and nearby allies. Daybreak final blows grant both effects.
displayProperties.name: Embers of Light

displayProperties.description: Powered melee final blows unleash a damaging explosion. Finishers and final blows against more powerful targets increase the radius and damage of the explosion.
displayProperties.name: Spheromatik Trigger

displayProperties.description:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

displayProperties.description: While you have a Stasis or Arc Super equipped, your Dodge becomes a longer range, faster moving shift that partially cloaks you during use. After shifting, your Stasis and Arc weapons gain a stacking damage bonus for a short time. Final blows with this bonus active refund class ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Light Shift

displayProperties.description:
Weighted Knife gains a second bounce. Rapid precision hits with your weapons grant Weighted Knife a significant damage bonus, bonus melee, and the ability to stun unshielded combatants for a short time.

Empowered Weighted Knife is strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.
displayProperties.name: Skittering Stinger

displayProperties.description: Your Daybreak projectiles deal more damage and scorch targets on impact. Your scorch is improved and you gain a small amount of melee energy when your scorch damages a target.
displayProperties.name: Rites of Ember

displayProperties.description:
Damaging a target with melee poisons them, dealing increasing damage over time. Defeating a poisoned target spreads the condition.

Provides a moderate benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all Weapons of Sorrow.
displayProperties.name: Grasp of the Devourer

displayProperties.description: Final blows from weapons with a damage type matching your Super create a burst of healing around you that grants allies restoration. After reviving or being revived, you gain an aura that provides overshields to you and nearby allies.
displayProperties.name: Kintsugi

displayProperties.description: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, rapid Stasis final blows grant Frost Armor. You heal a small amount whenever you gain Frost Armor. Replaces your class ability with a burst of Stasis energy that freezes nearby combatants, slows nearby opponents, and grants you increased Frost Armor.
displayProperties.name: Glacial Guard

displayProperties.description: This armor can equip Last Wish armor mods in its general socket.
displayProperties.name: Last Wish Armor

displayProperties.description: This armor can equip Garden of Salvation armor mods in its general socket.
displayProperties.name: Garden of Salvation Armor

displayProperties.description: This armor can equip Deep Stone Crypt armor mods in its general socket.
displayProperties.name: Deep Stone Crypt Armor

displayProperties.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
displayProperties.name: Marksman's Dodge

displayProperties.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
displayProperties.name: Gambler's Dodge

displayProperties.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
displayProperties.name: Towering Barricade

displayProperties.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
displayProperties.name: Rally Barricade

displayProperties.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
displayProperties.name: Healing Rift

displayProperties.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
displayProperties.name: Empowering Rift

displayProperties.description: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
displayProperties.name: Glacier Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
displayProperties.name: Duskfield Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.
displayProperties.name: Coldsnap Grenade

displayProperties.description:
Toss a [Stasis] Stasis Shuriken at targets to damage and slow them.  

Provides multiple charges.
displayProperties.name: Withering Blade

displayProperties.description: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.
displayProperties.name: Shiver Strike

displayProperties.description: Raise your [Stasis] Stasis staff against your foe. Send a blast of [Stasis] Stasis forward to freeze your targets.
displayProperties.name: Penumbral Blast

displayProperties.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.
displayProperties.name: High Jump

displayProperties.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Jump

displayProperties.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.
displayProperties.name: Triple Jump

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.
displayProperties.name: High Lift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Lift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.
displayProperties.name: Catapult Lift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.
displayProperties.name: Strafe Glide

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.
displayProperties.name: Burst Glide

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
displayProperties.name: Balanced Glide

displayProperties.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
displayProperties.name: Silence and Squall

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
displayProperties.name: Glacial Quake

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
displayProperties.name: Winter's Wrath

displayProperties.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
displayProperties.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall

displayProperties.description:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.
displayProperties.name: Spectral Blades

displayProperties.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and bow weapons.
displayProperties.name: Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver

displayProperties.description:
Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside or near Ward of Dawn, you and your allies gain a Void overshield.
displayProperties.name: Ward of Dawn

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Summon a shield of Void Light. 
While Sentinel Shield is active:
[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.
displayProperties.name: Sentinel Shield

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
displayProperties.name: Twilight Arsenal

displayProperties.description:
Step between dimensions to subvert the laws of physics.

[Super Secondary]  : Teleport a short distance and release weakening seekers.

[Super Primary]  : Unleash a deadly Void eruption. A fully charged attack makes targets volatile.
displayProperties.name: Nova Warp

displayProperties.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb creates a singularity that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
displayProperties.name: Nova Bomb: Vortex

displayProperties.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

displayProperties.description: Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings target radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

displayProperties.description: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

displayProperties.description:
Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.

[Block] : Hold to deflect incoming projectiles with your Arc staff.

Deflecting a projectile grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.
displayProperties.name: Arc Staff

displayProperties.description:
Hurl your Arc Staff forward, embedding it into surfaces or large targets and jolting nearby targets.

After a short time, a devastating lightning bolt strikes the staff, overcharging it with Arc energy. While overcharged, your staff discharges lightning at nearby foes.
displayProperties.name: Gathering Storm

displayProperties.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
displayProperties.name: Storm's Edge

displayProperties.description:
Supercharge your fists and slam the ground with the force of a maelstrom. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Quickly dash forward, dealing damage to any impacted targets.

[Heavy Attack] : Slam your fists to the ground, blinding targets and dealing damage in an area around you, leaving aftershocks in your wake. Performing a slam from the air or after a dash deals additional damage.
displayProperties.name: Fists of Havoc

displayProperties.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
displayProperties.name: Thundercrash

displayProperties.description:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
displayProperties.name: Stormtrance

displayProperties.description:
Unleash a long-range channeled beam of concentrated Arc energy. Sustained damage on a single target creates a jolting lightning strike at their position.

 [Super]  while active to deactivate your Super early, saving Super energy.
displayProperties.name: Chaos Reach

displayProperties.description:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.
displayProperties.name: Combination Blow

displayProperties.description: Striking a target with this melee ability blinds them, amplifies you, and grants you a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.
displayProperties.name: Disorienting Blow

displayProperties.description:
After sprinting for a short time, activate your charged melee ability to slam shoulder-first into your target, damaging and blinding targets in an area around them.

While you are amplified, the blind radius is increased.
displayProperties.name: Seismic Strike

displayProperties.description:
After sprinting and while airborne, activate your charged melee ability to slam to the ground, dealing damage to nearby targets.

Gain stacks of Bolt Charge based on number of targets hit by Ballistic Slam.
displayProperties.name: Ballistic Slam

displayProperties.description:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.
displayProperties.name: Thunderclap

displayProperties.description:
Fire an Arc projectile forward that releases a perpendicular lightning strike after a short time.

While amplified, Ball Lightning releases additional lightning strikes before detonating.
displayProperties.name: Ball Lightning

displayProperties.description:
An extended range melee that jolts your target and chains lightning to nearby targets.

While amplified, it creates an additional set of chains.
displayProperties.name: Chain Lightning

displayProperties.description:
Strand Meditations can be spent at the Pouka Pond to unlock additional Strand grenades, Aspects, and Fragments. 

Collect Strand Meditations by using Strand anywhere in the system and completing activities in Neomuna.

Additional Strand Meditations are earned from all sources while in the Vex Incursion Zone in Neomuna.
displayProperties.name: Strand Meditations

displayProperties.description: Used with Upgraded Event Cards to acquire Event Ticket rewards.
displayProperties.name: Event Ticket

displayProperties.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
displayProperties.name: Silkstrike

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
displayProperties.name: Bladefury

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
displayProperties.name: Needlestorm

displayProperties.description: Throw a rope dart that bounces between targets, damaging and severing them. The dart will return to you once it's done, returning melee energy to you for each target hit. Press [Melee] just as the dart gets back to you to catch it and increase the amount of energy returned.
displayProperties.name: Threaded Spike

displayProperties.description: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.
displayProperties.name: Frenzied Blade

displayProperties.description: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.
displayProperties.name: Arcane Needle

displayProperties.description: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
displayProperties.name: Shackle Grenade

displayProperties.description: A woven projectile that reweaves itself into Threadlings while in flight.
displayProperties.name: Threadling Grenade

displayProperties.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
displayProperties.name: Grapple

displayProperties.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
displayProperties.name: Marksman's Dodge

displayProperties.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
displayProperties.name: Gambler's Dodge

displayProperties.description: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
displayProperties.name: Towering Barricade

displayProperties.description: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.
displayProperties.name: Rally Barricade

displayProperties.description: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.
displayProperties.name: Healing Rift

displayProperties.description:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.
displayProperties.name: Empowering Rift

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.

displayProperties.name: Burst Glide

displayProperties.description: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.
displayProperties.name: Balanced Glide

displayProperties.description:
Archie found this under a chair in the Bazaar. Someone was probably angry they couldn't use it.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
displayProperties.name: Expired Ramen Coupon

displayProperties.description:
Archie found this while poking through the offices of the Lunar Complex. Whoever it belonged to would probably be saying "I was right!" right now.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
displayProperties.name: Spinfoil Hat

displayProperties.description:
Archie snagged this from Devrim's hideout while he wasn't looking. It once held something delicious, but the contents have spilled out.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
displayProperties.name: Devrim's Favorite Mug

displayProperties.description:
Archie found this sitting next to a Wizard's crown while exploring around the Hellmouth. He thought it was cool.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
displayProperties.name: A Cool Rock

displayProperties.description:
Archie picked this up in the Dreaming City—or at least what looked like the Dreaming City. Some weird stuff happened afterward, but Archie has just been gnawing on it since.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
displayProperties.name: Ahamkara Bone

displayProperties.description:
Archie went through a ton of tokens to get this from the Thrilladrome. He's not sure how it exists, but we don't need to worry about that.

This item has no use and can be safely dismantled… though Archie might be sad.
displayProperties.name: Archie Plush Toy

displayProperties.description: Targets damaged by Arcane Needle emit a suspending detonation when defeated. Landing multiple Arcane Needles or Needlestorm on the same target immediately triggers a larger, more powerful detonation. Defeating suspended targets grants melee energy. Your Arcane Needles are strong against [Shield-Piercing]Barrier Champions.
displayProperties.name: Stylostixis

displayProperties.description: Gain an additional Frenzied Blade charge. Frenzied Blade and Flechette Storm briefly increase their damage with each strike. Pulses from your Banner of War return melee energy based on the number of allies healed.
displayProperties.name: Wish-Dragon's Talons

displayProperties.description: Your Threaded Specter has increased duration and durability, and damaging it releases additional Threadlings. While near your Threaded Specter, you do not appear on radar.
displayProperties.name: Double Down

displayProperties.description: Activating Ascension or Tempest Strike throws bouncing explosives at nearby targets that jolt and damage them. Jolting nearby targets grants you damage resistance.
displayProperties.name: The Gift of Certainty

displayProperties.description: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret. Healing allies occasionally spawns an Orb of Power.
displayProperties.name: The Lost Voice

displayProperties.description: Weapon precision hits or final blows have a chance to load a Kinetic Exodus micro-missile. Activating your class ability fires loaded Exodus micro-missiles. Damaging targets with Exodus micro-missiles temporarily increases the damage you deal with other micro-missiles and Rocket Launchers.
displayProperties.name: Danger Close

displayProperties.description: Your weapons ready quicker and are more stable. Using your class ability temporarily increases this benefit and reloads your equipped weapon from reserves.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Dragon

displayProperties.description: Hits and final blows with your Super will return Super energy after it ends.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Galanor

displayProperties.description: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability grants you a temporary damage bonus for weapons matching that ability's element.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Foetracer

displayProperties.description: Powered melee final blows trigger an ignition.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Caliban

displayProperties.description: Allies inside the Duskfield grenade field gain Frost Armor and targets inside the field deal reduced damage.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Renewal

displayProperties.description: Gain Woven Mail when you use your grenade.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Cyrtarachne

displayProperties.description: Your Void weapons gain volatile rounds after you emerge from being invisible.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Gyrfalcon

displayProperties.description: Dealing damage with a powered melee or being hit by a melee attack will allow you to follow up with an extremely powerful Arc melee counterpunch.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Liar

displayProperties.description: Dodging gives a small health and shield bump.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Wormhusk

displayProperties.description: Gain an additional class ability charge.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Coyote

displayProperties.description: Final blows with weapons that have a damage type matching your Super's element grant you Super energy.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Harmony

displayProperties.description: Casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Filaments

displayProperties.description: Damaging targets with your melee poisons them. Defeating a poisoned target spreads the condition.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Necrotic

displayProperties.description: Your grenades recharge quicker on hits. The seeker spawned from Coldsnap grenades travels farther.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Osmiomancy

displayProperties.description: Temporarily gain greatly increased melee and grenade regeneration after your Super ends.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Apotheosis

displayProperties.description: Rifts periodically release Arc shockwaves.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Vesper

displayProperties.description: Your Rift provides damage reduction to allies standing in it.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Stag

displayProperties.description: Grenades recharge from empowered weapon damage, with empowered weapon final blows granting more energy.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Starfire

displayProperties.description: Destroying a Tangle spawns Threadlings.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Swarm

displayProperties.description: Gain an additional melee charge.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Claw

displayProperties.description: Powered melee or finisher final blows unleash a damaging explosion.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Severance

displayProperties.description: Your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Activating Thruster creates Stasis crystals.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Hoarfrost

displayProperties.description: Gain bonus damage for weapons matching your Super's element when your Super ends.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Eternal Warrior

displayProperties.description: Improves Drengr's Lash. Drengr's Lash projectiles track targets more aggressively and travel farther.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Abeyant

displayProperties.description: Move faster while guarding with the Unbreakable shield. Damage blocked with Unbreakable is converted to grenade energy.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Bear

displayProperties.description: Damaging a target with a powered melee causes all nearby targets to suffer lightning strikes and become jolted.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Contact

displayProperties.description: Final blows with weapons that have a damage type matching your Super's element create a burst of healing around you that grants allies restoration.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Scars

displayProperties.description: Your class ability unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch nearby targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Horn

displayProperties.description: Creates a healing pulse when your class ability is activated. Healing allies provides class ability energy.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Alpha Lupi

displayProperties.description: Gain an additional grenade charge.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Armamentarium

displayProperties.description: Finishers and powered melee final blows grant invisibility.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Assassin

displayProperties.description: Using an ability empowers the other two abilities, granting them improved energy regeneration.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Inmost Light

displayProperties.description: Weapons ready very quickly.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Ophidian

displayProperties.description: While your Super energy is full, picking up an Orb of Power overcharges your Super, granting it bonus damage.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of the Star-Eater

displayProperties.description: Improves melee damage when you're surrounded.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Synthoceps

displayProperties.description: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant a stacking grenade damage bonus and improved grenade regeneration.
displayProperties.name: Spirit of Verity

displayProperties.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
displayProperties.name: Storm's Edge

displayProperties.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.
displayProperties.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall

displayProperties.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.
displayProperties.name: Golden Gun: Marksman

displayProperties.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.
displayProperties.name: Silence and Squall

displayProperties.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
displayProperties.name: Silkstrike

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
displayProperties.name: Twilight Arsenal

displayProperties.description:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.
displayProperties.name: Hammer of Sol

displayProperties.description: Hurtle through the air like a missile and crash into targets to inflict meteoric damage.
displayProperties.name: Thundercrash

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.
displayProperties.name: Glacial Quake

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Create two woven blades and roam the battlefield. While active:

[Light Attack]  : Perform a leaping slash towards nearby targets, severing them on hit and dealing bonus damage to suspended targets. Each successful hit briefly increases your attack speed and grants energy for your heavy attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Unleash a heavy upward slash, creating two suspending projectiles that seek out targets.
displayProperties.name: Bladefury

displayProperties.description:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.
displayProperties.name: Song of Flame

displayProperties.description:
Hurl an explosive bolt of Void Light at a target, disintegrating those caught within its blast.

Nova Bomb travels slowly and seeks targets. Detonations shatter into smaller seeker projectiles.
displayProperties.name: Nova Bomb: Cataclysm

displayProperties.description:
Chain Arc Lightning from your hands to electrify targets with devastating streams of Arc Light that intensify over time. Casting Stormtrance creates a jolting shockwave underneath you.

[Sprint]  : Teleport forward, consuming a small amount of Super energy.
displayProperties.name: Stormtrance

displayProperties.description:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis staff. While your Super is active:

[Super Primary]  : Cast out a barrage of [Stasis] Stasis shards that freeze targets.

[Super Secondary]  : Cast out a shockwave that shatters all frozen targets.
displayProperties.name: Winter's Wrath

displayProperties.description:
[Super]  : Conjure a hail of deadly woven needles.

After embedding themselves in the environment, the needles will re-weave into a host of Threadlings.

Threadlings you create will return to you and perch if they can't find any nearby targets. Damaging targets with your weapons or melee will send out perched Threadlings to attack.
displayProperties.name: Needlestorm

displayProperties.description:
Toss a [Stasis] Stasis Shuriken at targets to damage and slow them.  

Provides multiple charges.
displayProperties.name: Withering Blade

displayProperties.description: Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings target radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.
displayProperties.name: Snare Bomb

displayProperties.description: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.
displayProperties.name: Knife Trick

displayProperties.description:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.
displayProperties.name: Combination Blow

displayProperties.description: Throw a rope dart that bounces between targets, damaging and severing them. The dart will return to you once it's done, returning melee energy to you for each target hit. Press [Melee] just as the dart gets back to you to catch it and increase the amount of energy returned.
displayProperties.name: Threaded Spike

displayProperties.description: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.
displayProperties.name: Shield Throw

displayProperties.description: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.
displayProperties.name: Shiver Strike

displayProperties.description:
After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.
displayProperties.name: Hammer Strike

displayProperties.description:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.
displayProperties.name: Thunderclap

displayProperties.description: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.
displayProperties.name: Frenzied Blade

displayProperties.description: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.
displayProperties.name: Arcane Needle

displayProperties.description:
Launch an unstable ball of Void energy that detonates when it nears a target, pushing them away from the blast and making them volatile.  

Provides multiple charges.
displayProperties.name: Pocket Singularity

displayProperties.description: Snap your fingers to create a fan of burning sparks that explode and scorch targets.
displayProperties.name: Incinerator Snap

displayProperties.description:
An extended range melee that jolts your target and chains lightning to nearby targets.

While amplified, it creates an additional set of chains.
displayProperties.name: Chain Lightning

displayProperties.description: Raise your [Stasis] Stasis staff against your foe. Send a blast of [Stasis] Stasis forward to freeze your targets.
displayProperties.name: Penumbral Blast

displayProperties.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
displayProperties.name: Grapple

displayProperties.description: A grenade that attaches to targets and explodes twice.
displayProperties.name: Magnetic Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, releasing multiple drones that seek nearby targets. Each drone slightly scorches affected targets.
displayProperties.name: Swarm Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.
displayProperties.name: Arcbolt Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
displayProperties.name: Duskfield Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that creates walls out of [Stasis] Stasis crystals to block damage and freeze targets; these walls can be shattered for damage.
displayProperties.name: Glacier Grenade

displayProperties.description: An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.
displayProperties.name: Suppressor Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.
displayProperties.name: Thermite Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.
displayProperties.name: Pulse Grenade

displayProperties.description: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.
displayProperties.name: Shackle Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that creates a Vortex that pulls targets inward and continually damages those trapped inside.
displayProperties.name: Vortex Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that cures allies on impact and creates an Orb of benevolent Solar Light, granting restoration to allies when picked up.
displayProperties.name: Healing Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.
displayProperties.name: Storm Grenade

displayProperties.description: A grenade that freezes on impact and sends another seeker to find and freeze targets.

• Blocking an attack immediately after guarding increases damage for a short duration.

• Rapid final blows grant ammo to this weapon and trigger health regeneration.
• Increases damage against rank-and-file combatants.

displayProperties.description:

• Landing three melee or throw attacks grants ammo to this weapon.
• Increases damage against bosses and vehicles.
displayProperties.name: Offensive Form

• [Strand] Severs targets.

You gain an air move jetpack. Weapon and Arc powered melee final blows build up Jetpack Fuel.

displayProperties.description:
Includes the Red War story campaign.

Humanity's Last Safe City has fallen to an overwhelming invasion force led by Dominus Ghaul, the imposing commander of the brutal Red Legion. He has stripped the City's Guardians of their power and forced the survivors to flee. You will venture to mysterious, unexplored worlds of our solar system to discover an arsenal of devastating weapons and powerful armor.

You can pick up this quest from Amanda Holliday in the Tower Hangar.
displayProperties.name: The Red War

displayProperties.description:
Includes the Curse of Osiris story campaign.

Uncover the true story of the greatest Warlock who ever lived, unravel the mystery of the Infinite Forest, and stop the Vex from ushering in a dark future where only they remain.

You can pick up this quest from Amanda Holliday in the Tower Hangar.
displayProperties.name: Curse of Osiris

displayProperties.description:
Includes the Warmind story campaign.

Golden Age satellites slam into the surface of the Hellas Basin on Mars. Icy glaciers thaw, revealing the core of the Warmind Rasputin—and an ancient Hive army, bent on its destruction.

You can pick up this quest from Amanda Holliday in the Tower Hangar.
displayProperties.name: Warmind

displayProperties.description: Upgrade your arsenal with the Forsaken Pack, which includes access to more than 20 Forsaken Exotic weapons, the "Shattered Throne" dungeon, and "Last Wish" raid. Owners also get 3 Forsaken Ciphers to instantly unlock any 3 Forsaken Exotic weapons of their choosing (raid and dungeon weapons excluded).
displayProperties.name: Forsaken Pack

displayProperties.description:
The Shadowkeep Pack introduces over 15 Exotic weapons and armor to collect, the "Garden of Salvation" raid, "Pit of Heresy" dungeon, and Scarlet Keep Nightfall. 

The Shadowkeep campaign is free in Destiny 2 and does not require this pack.
displayProperties.name: Shadowkeep Pack

displayProperties.description:
The Beyond Light Pack introduces over 15 Exotic weapons and armor to collect, the "Deep Stone Crypt" raid, as well as two Nightfalls: The Glassway and Proving Grounds. 

The Beyond Light campaign and Stasis subclass are free in Destiny 2 and do not require this pack.
displayProperties.name: Beyond Light Pack

displayProperties.description: Savathûn has been brought out of hiding, revealing a harrowing discovery that shakes the Vanguard. As Xivu Arath prepares to capture her sister, Savathûn offers you a bargain: free her from her worm, and she will reveal the truth about the Darkness.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Lost

displayProperties.description: Xûr invites you to the shores of Eternity where your skill will be tested… and rewarded. Celebrate 30 years of Bungie with new content that pays homage to a legendary legacy of gaming.
displayProperties.name: Bungie 30th Anniversary Pack

displayProperties.description:
Delve into Savathûn's twisted throne world to uncover the mystery of how she and her Lucent Brood stole the Light.

Learn the secrets required to craft all-new weapons, a new weapon archetype, and take back the Light.
displayProperties.name: The Witch Queen

displayProperties.description:
Delve into Savathûn's twisted throne world to uncover the mystery of how she and her Lucent Brood stole the Light. Learn the secrets required to craft all-new weapons, including a new Glaive weapon archetype, and take back the Light.

The Deluxe Edition includes The Witch Queen expansion plus 4 Seasons of Destiny 2 (begins on 2.22.22), two new dungeons in Year 5, a new Exotic SMG with catalyst and ornament, and a new Throne World Exotic Sparrow.
displayProperties.name: The Witch Queen Deluxe Edition

displayProperties.description: The Witch Queen Deluxe Edition + Bungie 30th Anniv. Bundle combines all the content from both The Witch Queen Deluxe Edition and the Bungie 30th Anniversary Pack.
displayProperties.name: The Witch Queen Deluxe + 30th Anniv. Bundle

displayProperties.description: When Savathûn's Lucent Hive threaten the source of the Guardians' power, survival depends on the fragile alliance between the Vanguard and Empress Caiatl. Wielding a spear imbued with Light-suppressing technology, the Guardian must work with Lord Saladin and Caiatl's most trusted Psion to search for secrets in the minds of the Lucent Hive and stop their ghoulish plans.
displayProperties.name: Season of the Risen

displayProperties.description: The Witch Queen Dungeon Key provides access to two dungeons: "Duality" and "Spire of the Watcher."
displayProperties.name: The Witch Queen Dungeon Key

displayProperties.description: The prison ship of the exiled Cabal Emperor Calus has returned. But its reappearance heralds the beginning of the end as the once-dormant lunar Pyramid stirs to life once more. With the aid of Eris Morn's witchcraft, the Guardian must work with Empress Caiatl, Commander Zavala, and Crow to unravel the mysteries of the Leviathan and the lunar Pyramid and stop Calus before it is too late.

displayProperties.description:
The final shape looms—a nightmarish calcification of reality into the Witness's twisted design. Embark on an adventure into the heart of the Traveler, harness the power of three new Super abilities, and finish the War of Light and Darkness. 

The Annual Pass edition includes The Final Shape story campaign, a new destination, three new Supers, new weapons and armor to collect, The Final Shape Dungeon Key, catalyst and ornament for the Tessellation Exotic, one Secret Stash delivered during each Episode, Exotic Sparrow, and all three Episodes in the year of The Final Shape.

displayProperties.description:
The Ultimate edition includes two expansions: The Edge of Fate and Renegades. 

The Edge of Fate expansion includes a story campaign, new destination, new destination abilities, and access to the raid and epic raid. 

The Renegades expansion will feature a new story campaign, a new game mode, and access to the dungeon. 

This edition also includes the Dark Side Legends Pack, catalyst and ornament for the New Land Beyond Exotic, one secret stash delivered during each major update, an Exotic Sparrow, four Rewards Passes, and new weapons and armor to collect in each expansion.
displayProperties.name: Destiny 2: Year of Prophecy Ultimate Edition

displayProperties.description:
The Year of Prophecy edition includes two expansions: The Edge of Fate and Renegades. 

The Edge of Fate expansion includes a story campaign, new destination, new destination abilities, and access to the raid and epic raid. 

The Renegades expansion will feature a new story campaign, a new game mode, and access to the dungeon.

This edition also includes four Rewards Passes and new weapons and armor to collect in each expansion.

displayProperties.description: "We found this on the corpse of that Vex Minotaur on the Moon. It's a core of some kind. Definitely Vex made… but I can't verify exactly what, when, where… or why. We could find the information we need by tapping into a Vex construct, but there are none on the Moon…" —Ghost
displayProperties.name: Divine Fragmentation

displayProperties.description: "I had to dig deep into encrypted Vex data to find anything regarding the core. I didn't find much—only that it's designed for decryption of something and that its origin lies with the Sol Divisive Vex. I couldn't learn anything further. It's broken and its data is largely corrupted. We might be able to repair it if we had access to Sol Divisive parts." —Ghost
displayProperties.name: Divine Fragmentation

displayProperties.description: "The Decryption Core is mended, but remains inactive. I was able to mine it for further data, and there are segments of data in a language I'm unable to decipher. Let me see if I can define its resonant energy pattern—wait, what? That's the same energy that pulsates from the Nightmare Essences. The energy signature is weak, but we should have the means to empower it." —Ghost
displayProperties.name: Divine Fragmentation

displayProperties.description: "I've fully analyzed the Decryption Core now that we've empowered it. There's a ton more data in here—but again, I don't understand most of its language. I was able to extract some key information, sporadic words here and there. 'Garden… Defenses… Guardians…' I haven't made complete sense of it yet, but there's only one Garden I know of associated with the Sol Divisive." —Ghost
displayProperties.name: Divine Fragmentation
